author: tomicalover
body:
Username: tomicalover

Reason for ban: Infractions and rudeness.

Why I should be unbanned: Ever since my ban from over a year ago, I have been trying to get unbanned but with no luck because no one ever answered my emails. Avicus is is one of my most favorite servers and I would love if I could be unbanned. I am severely sorry for the rudeness and infractions. I often got angry that staff would not listen to my legitimate reports. So please unban me, I would not like my Gold rank to go to waste.
